title: NotificationDeliveryState
description: Truthful lifecycle state for one notification delivery attempt

ATTEMPTED.description: The transport attempt started but produced no stronger receipt

ACCEPTED.description: An intermediary or destination accepted the message without confirmed recipient delivery

DELIVERED.description: The channel-specific final delivery boundary confirmed delivery

FAILED.description: The attempt produced a classified failure

UNKNOWN.description: The attempt outcome is ambiguous, for example after loss of acknowledgement
